mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which precedes corporate earnings weakness and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE >= 5.0%) signals a policy response to economic weakness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through stimulus expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 and UNRATE >= 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 1100), increased residential construction activity signals stronger consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1100.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market indicated by high non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 140,000) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 240.0 (CPIAUCSL > 240.0) signals elevated inflation, prompting potential monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and housing starts (HOUST > 1100) indicates robust economic growth across supply and demand sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100 and HOUST > 1100.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing expansion regime (INDPRO > 100), rising industrial output signals strong corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.
